safety.sql_policy: Trusted static SELECT statements only; separators, mutating/admin keywords, outfile/dumpfile and selected side-effecting functions are rejected
safety.limitation: This defense-in-depth filter is not a general SQL parser. Database-enforced read-only access remains mandatory for migration execution.

repository_sanitization.note: Historical temporal result hashes covered exact low-entropy extrema and were removed. Aggregate counts and query definitions remain; v2.2.0 no longer selects extrema.

queries.purpose: Validate approved schema and capture non-secret server metadata.
queries.normalized_sql: SELECT DATABASE() AS database_name, VERSION() AS database_version, @@version_comment AS version_comment, @@character_set_database AS character_set_database, @@collation_database AS collation_database, @@global.read_only AS global_read_only, @@session.tx_read_only AS session_transaction_read_only, @@session.tx_isolation AS transaction_isolation, @@global.log_bin AS binary_logging_enabled, @@global.gtid_binlog_pos AS source_coordinate

queries.purpose: Capture privilege names only; account identity is not returned.
queries.normalized_sql: SELECT PRIVILEGE_TYPE FROM information_schema.USER_PRIVILEGES WHERE GRANTEE = CONCAT(CHAR(39), SUBSTRING_INDEX(CURRENT_USER(), CHAR(64), 1), CHAR(39), CHAR(64), CHAR(39), SUBSTRING_INDEX(CURRENT_USER(), CHAR(64), -1), CHAR(39)) ORDER BY PRIVILEGE_TYPE

queries.purpose: Capture privilege names on approved uuhms only; account identity is not returned.
queries.normalized_sql: SELECT PRIVILEGE_TYPE FROM information_schema.SCHEMA_PRIVILEGES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = ? AND GRANTEE = CONCAT(CHAR(39), SUBSTRING_INDEX(CURRENT_USER(), CHAR(64), 1), CHAR(39), CHAR(64), CHAR(39), SUBSTRING_INDEX(CURRENT_USER(), CHAR(64), -1), CHAR(39)) ORDER BY PRIVILEGE_TYPE

queries.purpose: Complete Classic table/view catalogue.

queries.purpose: Complete Classic 55-table column catalogue.

queries.purpose: Complete Classic index catalogue.

queries.purpose: Declared Classic primary/unique/foreign-key constraints.

queries.purpose: Independent foreign-key evidence from referenced columns; an empty result establishes no declared foreign-key columns visible to this account.
